title: Observation of room temperature intrinsic nonlinear thermoelectric effects in low-dimensional semimetals
summary: Nonreciprocal control of thermoelectric responses offers a promising strategy for next-generation thermal-management and energy-conversion. While nonlinear electrical transport has recently emerged as an intrinsic property of low-symmetry quantum materials, their thermoelectric counterparts have not been demonstrated.
